job.job_description:
As a Principal AI Engineer, you will define the architectural vision and governance standards for GenAI solutions at scale. You will lead the design of intelligent systems leveraging LLMs, agentic workflows, and vector-based retrieval strategies, while ensuring alignment with enterprise-level goals around security, performance, and reusability. This role operates at the intersection of deep technical expertise and cross-functional leadership.
Key Responsibilities Skills
Expert knowledge of Azure cloud services for designing, optimizing, and maintaining APIs
Strong expertise in Azure SQL, including performance tuning and optimization
Strong proficiency in API design principles and performance optimization techniques
Solid understanding of, and experience with, enterprise-scale initiatives
Effective collaboration with Enterprise Architects and Platform Architects
Ability to understand business use cases and translate them into detailed technical designs
Strong sense of accountability and ownership
Strong proficiency in micro-services and micro front-end architecture
Excellent problem-solving skills with a large-scale, strategic mindset
Strong knowledge of security across application and data layers
Strong exposure to Visual Studio and modern development environments
Good knowledge of CI/CD processes and DevOps practices
Demonstrated expertise in building LLM-integrated systems, embedding pipelines, and agentic workflows in production environments
Deep understanding of prompt optimization, vector search, context management, and multi-step task orchestration
Experience with cloud-native delivery (Azure preferred), containerized workloads, and scalable microservices
Strong grasp of model safety, cost optimization, and observability in GenAI applications
Build reusable components (SDKs, prompt libraries, orchestration templates) to accelerate solution delivery
Experience integrating backend services with front-end applications; familiarity with UI functionality is a plus
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience, LangGraph, FastAPI, AWS, transferable Azure skills.
